title: Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis

summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models.
takeaways: In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions.
Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative.

Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality.
